name: brimkern
description: On-device AI for your site: one script tag runs a real language model on your visitor's GPU (WebGPU). No server, no API key, no per-token cost, nothing leaves the browser.
author: Romain Khanoyan (https://romainkhanoyan.fr)

scripts.prepublishOnly: node ../../scripts/build-sdk.mjs && node -e "const f=require('fs');for(const p of ['dist/brimkern.mjs','dist/brimkern.iife.js','dist/index.d.ts'])if(!f.existsSync(p))throw new Error('build manquant : '+p)"
